Technical Presentation and Demonstration (Stage 3) 
Shortlisted vendors (typically the top 3-5 however it will be capped at no more than 7 based on Stage

Technical Presentation and Demonstration (Stage 3) 
Shortlisted vendors (typically the top 3-5 however it will be capped at no more than 7 based on Stage 
2 scores and those vendors reaching a minimum 70% threshold on their technical proposal score) will 
be invited to a live technical presentation. The evaluation criteria for the presentation will be 
developed and shared uniformly with all shortlisted vendors prior to their invitation. 
 
These criteria will be derived based on the themes and quality observed in Stage 2 submissions to 
ensure relevance and focus. 
The goal of this phase is to: 
 
 Validate vendor claims through live demonstration of platform and mobile app 
 Assess integration depth, system realism, and architectural alignment 
 Clarify risk areas and transition planning 
 
Scoring and Weight 
Presentation phase represents 30% of the total technical score (i.e., 30 out of 100 points). Scoring will

 Clarify risk areas and transition planning 
 
Scoring and Weight 
Presentation phase represents 30% of the total technical score (i.e., 30 out of 100 points). Scoring will 
follow the same 0–10 rubric and criteria will be defined in advance and applied consistently. 
 
Combined Score and Financial Evaluation

16 
UNFCCC RFP 2025-013 
Only vendors passing both Stage 2 and Stage 3 with a combined technical score of 70 points or above 
will proceed to the financial evaluation. Final rankings will be determined using the Combined 
Scoring Method: 
 
 TP Rating = (Vendor’s Technical Score / Highest Technical Score) × 70 
 FP Rating = (Lowest Price / Vendor’s Price) × 30 
 Combined Score = TP Rating + FP Rating 
 
The contract shall be awarded to the vendor with the highest Combined Score. 
 
In cases where a vendor submits both a modular and an end-to-end solution, each proposal will be 
evaluated independently under the same criteria. The version with the highest Combined Score will be 
used as the basis for award recommendation.

Technical Presentation and Demonstration (Stage 3) 
Shortlisted vendors (typically the top 3-5 however it will be capped at no more than 7 based on Stage 
2 scores and those vendors reaching a minimum 70% threshold on their technical proposal score) will 
be invited to a live technical presentation. The evaluation criteria for the presentation will be 
developed and shared uniformly with all shortlisted vendors prior to their invitation. 
 
These criteria will be derived based on the themes and quality observed in Stage 2 submissions to 
ensure relevance and focus. 
The goal of this phase is to: 
 
 Validate vendor claims through live demonstration of platform and mobile app 
 Assess integration depth, system realism, and architectural alignment 
 Clarify risk areas and transition planning

Scoring and Weight 
Presentation phase represents 30% of the total technical score (i.e., 30 out of 100 points). Scoring will 
follow the same 0–10 rubric and criteria will be defined in advance and applied consistently. 
 
Combined Score and Financial Evaluation

16 
UNFCCC RFP 2025-013 
Only vendors passing both Stage 2 and Stage 3 with a combined technical score of 70 points or above 
will proceed to the financial evaluation. Final rankings will be determined using the Combined 
Scoring Method: 
 
 TP Rating = (Vendor’s Technical Score / Highest Technical Score) × 70 
 FP Rating = (Lowest Price / Vendor’s Price) × 30 
 Combined Score = TP Rating + FP Rating 
 
The contract shall be awarded to the vendor with the highest Combined Score. 
 
In cases where a vendor submits both a modular and an end-to-end solution, each proposal will be 
evaluated independently under the same criteria. The version with the highest Combined Score will be 
used as the basis for award recommendation.
